# Tank Talks

> Tank Talks (tanktalks.sdfkjh.com) is a freshwater aquarium blog covering fish, shrimp, aquatic plants, and water chemistry. It pairs practical how-to and troubleshooting articles with recommended-gear roundups. As an Amazon Associate, Tank Talks earns from qualifying purchases; affiliate links are disclosed on every article. The focus is freshwater only — community tanks, nano tanks, planted tanks, and shrimp keeping.

Full page content for language models: https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/llms-full.txt

## Sections

- [Home](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/): latest articles and featured guides.
- [Start here](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/tools.html): beginner orientation and core concepts.
- [Troubleshooting](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/troubleshooting.html): diagnose common tank problems (cloudy water, algae, sick fish, stalled cycles).
- [Articles](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/): full article index.
- [Recommended gear](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/gear.html): vetted equipment picks.
- [About](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/legal/about.html): who runs the site and how it earns.

## All articles (9)

- [The nitrogen cycle, properly explained](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/nitrogen-cycle-properly-explained.html): the single most important thing to understand about a freshwater aquarium, and where the hobby's folk knowledge is most outdated.
- [Best nano fish for a 10 gallon planted tank in 2026](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/best-nano-fish-10-gallon-planted-tank-2026.html): which fish actually thrive at the 10-gallon scale.
- [Neocaridina vs Caridina — picking your first shrimp species](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/neocaridina-vs-caridina-first-shrimp.html): two fundamentally different water chemistries; starting with the wrong one is the most common reason new keepers fail.
- [How to acclimate new shrimp: the drip method](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/shrimp-acclimation-drip-method.html): the two hours after arrival decide survival; the drip method without the cargo-cult variations.
- [Cherry shrimp breeding: why your colony isn't growing](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/cherry-shrimp-breeding-colony-not-growing.html): a stalled Neocaridina colony is almost always one of the same five things.
- [How I finally cracked nitrate control — 6 months in my 40 gallon](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/nitrate-control-40-gallon.html): what actually works for nitrate in a planted community tank.
- [Bucephalandra: the beginner's guide to keeping "buce" alive](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/bucephalandra-keeping-buce-alive.html): the mistakes that kill Bucephalandra, starting with burying the rhizome.
- [Java moss vs Christmas moss — which is actually better?](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/java-moss-vs-christmas-moss.html): they grow differently, look different up close, and serve different purposes.
- [Marimo moss balls: why every shrimp tank needs one](https://tanktalks.sdfkjh.com/articles/marimo-moss-balls-shrimp-tank.html): what marimo actually are and how to keep them round.
